systemic_findings: femaleSmokingRate=8 / maleSmokingRate=22 is a fabricated constant repeated across ALL 8 countries in this batch; replaced with WHO GHO 'Estimate of current tobacco smoking prevalence (age-standardized)' 2024 estimates everywhere a country-level estimate exists (all except Aruba).
Combined obesityRate/smokingRate fields were internally inconsistent with their own sexed components in several entries; corrected smokingRate to the mean of corrected sexed values.

The dataSource='REST Countries & World Bank API 2024' placeholder signature (pop 1000000 / income.p50 875 / costOfLivingIndex 38) did NOT occur in this batch; AW and BS carry that dataSource label but have distinct, mostly plausible values.

Most demographic/economic fields (population, life expectancy, unemployment, internet, adolescent fertility, labor-force gap) match World Bank API 2024 almost exactly - the batch was largely machine-generated from WB with fabricated smoking/HDI/minimum-wage sprinkled in.
Caucasus countries (AM, AZ) misfiled under 'Middle East & North Africa'.
